run_textual_inversion_training: run textual inversion training to learn a new visual concept from a dataset of images
create_add_tokens: create placeholder tokens in a tokenizer with initialized embeddings from an initializer token
save_learned_embeddings: save learned token embeddings to a binary file after training completes
load_multitoken_embeddings: load previously learned multi-token embeddings into a text encoder for inference
test_textual_inversion_dataset: test the TextualInversionDataset class with configurable templates and image preprocessing
